executors.description: Query current mainland China enterprise registration information.

actions.description: Find enterprise candidates from a name, abbreviation, or recognizable clue.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The enterprise name or recognizable clue from the user.

actions.result: Candidate enterprises for confirmation or a no-result response.

actions.description: Retrieve registration details for one exact identified enterprise. Use the selected candidate label verbatim and its identityRef as the result binding; do not shorten a branch name or substitute a parent/related entity.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The exact selected candidate label. Preserve the full label verbatim.

inputs.name: identity-ref
inputs.description: The selected candidate identityRef (normally its unified social credit code). The detail result must match it.

actions.result: A standardized registration summary only when the returned identity matches the supplied selected identityRef; otherwise a structured decision conflict.

actions.description: Read complete registered key-personnel records for one exact identified enterprise. This is source acquisition, not an instruction to deliver every person. Use relevant records for the user's requested roles; current appointments and titles absent from the registry require complementary sources.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The exact selected candidate label. Preserve the full label verbatim.

inputs.name: identity-ref
inputs.description: The selected candidate identityRef (normally its unified social credit code). The personnel result must match it.

actions.result: Source records with exact registered names and titles, or an explicit missing-field result. The caller must answer the original question from relevant evidence; this action does not establish current appointment status.
